title: Session revoked
description: A request ended a session that was active: the person signed out, or a sign-in in the browser that held the session replaced it (ST-14, AUD-01). A session that expires, or that the deactivation of its principal revokes, records no such event: whitetower.principal.deactivated.v1 records the deactivation. The revocations of a change of groups, like those of a deactivation, are recorded by whitetower.principal.groups_changed.v1 rather than by this event. It carries no token, nor any hash of one.

actor.description: Who ended it: the session's principal, who signed out, or whoever signed in in its place, who can be another person on a shared browser.

method.description: How the session that ended was signed in.

reason.description: signed_out: its principal signed out. replaced: a sign-in in the browser that held it revoked it.
